import zipfile, re, sys

def extract_docx_text\(filepath\):
    with zipfile.ZipFile\(filepath, 'r'\) as z:
        with z.open\('word/document.xml'\) as f:
            xml = f.read\(\).decode\('utf-8'\)
    text = re.sub\(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', xml\)
    text = re.sub\(r'\\s+', ' ', text\).strip\(\)
    return text

files = ['DOC1_PRD.docx', 'DOC2_SystemDesign.docx', 'DOC3_Wireframes.docx', 'DOC4_FeatureBreakdown.docx', 'DOC5_MasterPrompt.docx', 'DOC_UPDATES_v1.1.docx']
for f in files:
    sys.stdout.buffer.write\(f'=== {f} ===\\n'.encode\('utf-8'\)\)
    try:
        text = extract_docx_text\(f\)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write\(text[:6000].encode\('utf-8', errors='replace'\)\)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write\(b'\\n\\n'\)
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write\(f'ERROR: {e}\\n'.encode\('utf-8'\)\)
" 2>&1)
